Apple___Apple_scab.organic: Prune tree canopies to maximize sunlight and airflow. Apply liquid copper or sulfur sprays early in spring.
Apple___Apple_scab.chemical: Apply Captan, Mancozeb, or Myclobutanil fungicides at pink bud stage through petal fall.
Apple___Apple_scab.prevention: Rake and compost/burn fallen autumn leaves; avoid overhead irrigation.

Apple___Black_rot.organic: Prune out dead wood, mummified fruits, and bark cankers. Apply copper-based sprays during dormancy.
Apple___Black_rot.chemical: Apply Captan or Thiophanate-methyl sprays beginning at petal fall.
Apple___Black_rot.prevention: Sanitize pruning shears between cuts; prevent mechanical branch injuries.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.organic: Remove nearby eastern red cedar and juniper galls within 500 feet if possible.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.chemical: Spray Myclobutanil, Mancozeb, or Propiconazole at pink bud stage.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.prevention: Plant resistant apple varieties like Enterprise, Freedom, or Liberty.

Apple___healthy.organic: Apply organic compost and mulch around tree base annually.
Apple___healthy.prevention: Maintain annual pruning and inspect for codling moth or aphids.

Blueberry___healthy.organic: Maintain acidic soil pH (4.5 to 5.5) using pine bark mulch and sulfur pellets.
Blueberry___healthy.prevention: Ensure good drainage to prevent Phytophthora root rot.

Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.organic: Spray potassium bicarbonate, horticultural oils, or diluted neem oil (5ml/L).
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.chemical: Apply Myclobutanil, Quinoxyfen, or wettable sulfur fungicides.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Prune inner branches for good air circulation; avoid over-fertilizing with nitrogen.

Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.organic: Apply balanced organic fruit tree fertilizer in early spring.
Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.prevention: Inspect for cherry fruit flies and monitor soil moisture.

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.organic: Bury crop residues after harvest; apply biofungicides like Trichoderma harzianum.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.chemical: Apply strobilurin or triazole foliar fungicides (e.g., Azoxystrobin, Pyraclostrobin).
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.prevention: Practice a minimum 2-year crop rotation; plant certified resistant corn hybrids.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.organic: Plant early in the season to evade spore migration; eradicate volunteer corn.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.chemical: Apply Pyraclostrobin or Propiconazole if rust appears prior to tasseling.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.prevention: Select rust-resistant hybrids; avoid excess nitrogen application.

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.organic: Deep till post-harvest to speed up residue decomposition; use resistant open-pollinated seed.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.chemical: Spray Pyraclostrobin + Fluxapyroxad or Azoxystrobin at early symptom onset.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.prevention: Rotate crops with non-grasses (e.g., soybeans); avoid overhead pivot irrigation.

Corn_(maize)___healthy.organic: Maintain balanced N-P-K nutrition and adequate soil organic matter.
Corn_(maize)___healthy.prevention: Monitor weekly during silking and tasseling stages.

Grape___Black_rot.organic: Remove and destroy dried mummified berries; apply copper soap sprays early.
Grape___Black_rot.chemical: Spray Mancozeb, Ziram, or Captan from early bloom until 4 weeks post-bloom.
Grape___Black_rot.prevention: Keep canopy open and upright through proper shoot positioning to dry leaves quickly.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).organic: Prune vines only during dry weather; seal large pruning cuts with wound paste.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).chemical: Apply sodium tetraborate formulations; no cure for infected vines—manage stress.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).prevention: Disinfect pruning tools with 70% alcohol; replace severely declining vines.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.organic: Spray copper oxychloride or sulfur formulations after fruit harvest.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.chemical: Apply Mancozeb, Dithiocarbamate, or Azoxystrobin foliar sprays.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.prevention: Ensure good trellis airflow; collect and dispose of fallen autumn leaves.

Grape___healthy.organic: Annual vine training, compost application, and cluster thinning.
Grape___healthy.prevention: Routine leaf inspection for downy mildew and leafhoppers.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).pathogen: Bacterium (Candidatus Liberibacter asiaticus) spread by Asian Citrus Psyllid
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).organic: Release parasitic wasps (Tamarixia radiata); apply foliar zinc and manganese to prolong tree life.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).chemical: Control psyllid vectors with Imidacloprid, Thiamethoxam, or Cypermethrin.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).prevention: Plant only certified disease-free rootstock; remove severely infected trees promptly.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.organic: Apply dormant fixed copper sprays in late autumn after leaf fall and before bud break.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.chemical: Apply Oxytetracycline (Mycoshield) or low-rate copper during the growing season.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Plant windbreaks to prevent sandblasting bark wounds; select resistant cultivars.

Peach___healthy.organic: Prune for an open-center vase canopy to maximize sunlight penetration.
Peach___healthy.prevention: Inspect trunks for peach tree borer frass and monitor fruit development.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.organic: Spray copper octanoate combined with Bacillus subtilis bio-bactericide.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.chemical: Apply copper hydroxide mixed with Mancozeb to reduce bacterial copper resistance.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use hot-water treated certified seeds; never work in fields when leaves are wet.

Pepper,_bell___healthy.organic: Mulch soil to conserve moisture; ensure consistent calcium levels to prevent blossom end rot.
Pepper,_bell___healthy.prevention: Maintain proper plant spacing and crop rotation with non-solanaceous crops.

Potato___Early_blight.organic: Remove lower infected foliage. Spray copper soap or cold-pressed neem oil (5ml/L).
Potato___Early_blight.chemical: Apply Chlorothalonil, Mancozeb, or Azoxystrobin every 7–10 days.
Potato___Early_blight.prevention: Maintain a 3-year crop rotation; use drip irrigation to prevent wet foliage.

Potato___Late_blight.organic: Destroy and bag infected plants immediately. Apply protective copper sulfate sprays.
Potato___Late_blight.chemical: Apply systemic fungicides like Metalaxyl, Cymoxanil, or Fluopicolide immediately.
Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Plant certified disease-free seed tubers; eliminate volunteer potatoes and cull piles.

Potato___healthy.organic: Hill soil properly around developing tubers to prevent sunlight exposure and greening.
Potato___healthy.prevention: Ensure good drainage and maintain consistent soil moisture.

Raspberry___healthy.organic: Prune out spent floricanes after fruiting; mulch with wood chips.
Raspberry___healthy.prevention: Ensure well-drained sandy loam soil to prevent Phytophthora cane blight.

Soybean___healthy.organic: Inoculate seeds with Bradyrhizobium japonicum for natural nitrogen fixation.
Soybean___healthy.prevention: Rotate crops with corn or small grains to break pest life cycles.

Squash___Powdery_mildew.organic: Spray milk solution (40% milk, 60% water), potassium bicarbonate, or neem oil.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.chemical: Apply Myclobutanil, Trifloxystrobin, or sulfur at first sign of white spots.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Space plants generously (4–6 feet); plant powdery mildew-resistant squash hybrids.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.organic: Remove old infected leaves after fruiting; apply organic copper soap spray.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.chemical: Apply Captan or Thiophanate-methyl sprays early in spring as new growth emerges.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.prevention: Plant on raised beds with clean pine straw mulch to prevent soil splashing.

Strawberry___healthy.organic: Provide consistent drip irrigation and clean straw mulching.
Strawberry___healthy.prevention: Renew strawberry beds every 3 to 4 years to maintain plant vigor.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.organic: Apply copper-based bactericide mixed with Bacillus subtilis biofungicide.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.chemical: Apply copper hydroxide mixed with Mancozeb to enhance bacterial kill rate.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Avoid overhead watering; disinfect stakes and cages with 10% bleach.

Tomato___Early_blight.organic: Prune lower leaves up to 18 inches off the ground; apply heavy mulch to stop soil splashing.
Tomato___Early_blight.chemical: Apply Mancozeb, Chlorothalonil, or Azoxystrobin every 7–14 days.
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Stake plants upright for airflow; water strictly at soil level via drip irrigation.

Tomato___Late_blight.organic: Promptly pull and bag infected plants. Spray preventative fixed copper on surrounding plants.
Tomato___Late_blight.chemical: Apply Chlorothalonil, Famoxadone + Cymoxanil, or Dimethomorph immediately.
Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Never plant tomatoes next to potatoes; avoid overhead sprinkler systems.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.organic: Increase greenhouse ventilation; lower relative humidity below 85% with exhaust fans.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.chemical: Apply copper fungicides, Chlorothalonil, or Difenoconazole.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.prevention: Prune suckers to open internal air channels; space greenhouse plants generously.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.organic: Remove infected lower leaves immediately upon appearance. Apply organic copper spray.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.chemical: Apply Chlorothalonil or Mancozeb sprays at 7–10 day intervals.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.prevention: Deep-till soil in autumn to bury fungal spores; rotate away from nightshades for 3 years.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.organic: Release predatory mites (Phytoseiulus persimilis); spray insecticidal soap or neem oil.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.chemical: Apply miticides like Abamectin, Bifenazate, or Spiromesifen to leaf undersides.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.prevention: Maintain adequate irrigation; wash dusty field roadways which promote mite outbreaks.

Tomato___Target_Spot.organic: Prune dense lower foliage to speed up canopy drying after rains.
Tomato___Target_Spot.chemical: Apply Azoxystrobin, Boscalid, or Pyraclostrobin foliar sprays.
Tomato___Target_Spot.prevention: Keep plants and fruit off bare ground using trellises and plastic mulch.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.organic: Install yellow sticky insect traps; spray neem oil or pyrethrins to control whiteflies.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.chemical: Apply systemic insecticides (e.g., Imidacloprid, Dinotefuran) targeting whitefly nymphs.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.prevention: Use fine 50-mesh insect netting in nurseries; remove and destroy infected plants.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.organic: Wash hands with milk or soap before touching plants; destroy infected plants immediately.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.chemical: No chemical cure exists for viral plant infections.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.prevention: Smokers must wash hands (tobacco harbors mosaic virus); plant resistant seed varieties.

Tomato___healthy.organic: Provide consistent moisture and support with sturdy cages or stakes.
Tomato___healthy.prevention: Inspect leaf undersides weekly for early pests or discoloration.
